JSONPath Tester

Paste JSON and a JSONPath expression ($.a[0]['b'], [*], .*) to see every matched value.

Supported: $.dot, [0], ['key'], [*], .*

0 match(es)

📖 How to use

  1. Paste JSON in the left box.
  2. Type a JSONPath expression like $.store.book[*].title.
  3. Click Evaluate to see all matches.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which JSONPath syntax is supported?

$.dot names, [0] and ['k'] brackets, [*] and .* wildcards. Recursive descent (..) is not supported.

Do quoted keys work?

Yes — matching bracket syntax supports both single and double quotes.

Are filter expressions supported?

No — filters like [?(@.x>1)] are out of scope; use wildcards to explore.

Can I see where each match came from?

Yes — results are shown as a JSON array with their paths.
